title: SOC Update 08:40: Refund Phishing and "Plain Text" Claim

fields.cc: Tessa Brandt (Social Media Manager); Marcus Delaney (Chief Communications Officer)
fields.subject: INC-27-0309-01 UPDATE 08:40 ET – phishing campaign + viral plain-text claim
fields.note:
Two new things in the last 10 minutes.

(1) PHISHING. Our mail gateway quarantined 1,312 inbound messages sent to tallishome.example staff addresses that are also web store customer accounts. One copy is forwarded below.
FROM: 'Tallis Home Refunds' <refunds@tallis-refund-center.example>
SUBJECT: 'Your Tallis refund is ready, confirm card within 24 hours'
The body offers a $35 credit and has a CONFIRM CARD button that links to tallis-refund-center.example/confirm-card.
Header check: Return-Path is bounce@tallis-refund-center.example, SPF=none, DKIM=none. The domain was registered 2027-03-09 05:58 ET, 42 minutes before the WS-EXFIL-07 export alert.
Customers outside our gateway are getting it too. 18 replies under one post say so (screenshot attached).

(2) VIRAL CLAIM. @OhioDealDigger (52,300 followers) posted at 08:38 ET:
'CONFIRMED by a source: Tallis stored ALL customer passwords in PLAIN TEXT. If you ever reused your Tallis password, change EVERYTHING now. #TallisHack #TallisBreach'
It had 3,400 reposts in 12 minutes. Screenshot attached.
Cardinal's 08:10 check found the pwd column is bcrypt ($2b$12$…), not plain text.

I have not reported the domain to anyone yet. Who files the IC3 report? And does comms want the URL and screenshots for the platform takedown?
fields.signature:
Devon Park
On-Call Analyst, Security Operations Center
Tallis Home Products, Dayton, OH

original.to: Valued Customer (quarantined copy, 1 of 1,312 tallishome.example recipients)
original.subject: Your Tallis refund is ready, confirm card within 24 hours
original.body:
Dear Valued Tallis Customer,

We recently found a technical problem with our web store that may have affected your account. We are sorry for any inconvience. As a thank you for your loyalty, a $35.00 Tallis Home credit has been added to your account.

To release your refund, please confirm the card on file within 24 hours. Credits not confirmed in time will be cancelled for security reasons.

[ CONFIRM CARD ]
https://tallis-refund-center.example/confirm-card

You will be asked for your card number, expiry date and security code so we can match your refund to your account.

Thank you for choosing Tallis Home, where every kitchen is a happy kitchen!

Tallis Home Refunds Department
Customer Satisfaction Team

This is an automated message. Please do not reply to this email.

instructorNote: Core inject. It tests the TMPCDI 5 rumor protocol on two false, harmful claims at the same time. Watch whether SOCIAL logs both claims word for word without replying and sends the platform, registrar and host takedown request with the URL and screenshots. Watch whether the CISO takes the IC3 report and confirms bcrypt for the fact sheet. Watch whether COMMS approves a short factual reply that leads with the facts ("Tallis will never ask for a card number by email"; passwords were hashed) and does not repeat "plain text" as the headline. Also watch whether anyone rereads the 08:20 statement against the facts before posting again.
